request.description: I noticed small orange pustules on the upper surface of wheat leaves. Plants are at tillering stage and recent rainfall has been high. Severity appears low with about 5% leaf area affected.
Dark water-soaked lesions are spreading rapidly on tomato leaves and stems. We are in flowering stage with cool wet weather. About 20% of foliage is affected across multiple plants in the field.

Multiple olive fruits show puncture marks and internal tunneling consistent with Bactrocera oleae infestation. Over 40% of fruits are affected. Harvest is 6 weeks away and temperatures have been above 20C.
